title: Building Modern Architectures: Functional Core, Imperative Shell Revamp
summary: Explains Functional Core, Imperative Shell as an alternative to layered/hexagonal architecture, separating pure business logic from I/O via unidirectional dependency flow.
when-to-read: Read when evaluating architecture patterns for separating business logic from side effects, especially if the team is open to functional-programming influence in an OOP codebase. Do not read for general build-vs-buy or reliability trade-offs (see practices-of-reliable-software-design) — this is about one specific named pattern.
